2023-11-20
Claim opened after a report that the insured's vehicle was sideswiped while changing lanes on a multi-lane road. The

2023-11-22
Reviewed the policy and confirmed the driver is listed as a named driver and that coverage was in force at the time of

2024-01-10

collision as descrbied by the other driver.
2024-02-05
Spoke with two independent witnesses who each saw the sideswipe occur and gave accounts consistent with the
other driver's statement.
2024-02-26
Reviewed scene photographs and the damage estimate. The damage pattern along the passenger side matches the
impact described by all parties, and no prior damage to the vehicle is on record.
2024-04-13
Claimant reported neck and upper back pain with stiffness, consistent with a whiplash-type injury for a collision of this
kind. The attorney provided the initial medical records.
2024-04-23

the account given in every earlier conversation, with no changes in the sequence of events.
2024-06-04

2024-06-16

the current symptoms, so the current complaints are being evaluated with that in mind.
2024-06-19
Treatment followed a typical course of care and tapered as the claimant improved, with reduced visits and decreasing
reports of pain over the following weeks.
2024-06-23
Reviewed the full file. The reported injury is plausible for a crash of this type, the liability facts are supported by

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
